//===== rAthena Script =======================================
//= Sub-world: Morroc and the Sograt Desert
//===== Description: =========================================
//= Players cannot leave these 30 maps. The portals at the edge
//= are disabled. Any other way out (a Kafra teleport, a boat, a wing, a quest
//= warp, an old save point) brings them back to where they last arrived in
//= this world, or to the start. A save point outside moves to the start.
//= GMs (group 99) travel freely.
//=
//= Loaded with loadevent.txt by: setup-macos.sh start --sub-world morroc
//= Generated by tools/sub_worlds.py: edit the tool, not this file.
//===== Settings read by setup-macos.sh: =====================
//= start_point: morocc,156,46
//============================================================

-	script	SubWorld#morroc	-1,{
OnInit:
	setarray .maps$[0],
		"morocc", "morocc_in", "moc_ruins", "moc_fild07", "moc_fild11", "moc_fild12",
		"moc_fild16", "moc_fild17", "moc_fild18", "moc_fild19", "cmd_fild08", "cmd_fild09",
		"anthell01", "anthell02", "moc_pryd01", "moc_pryd02", "moc_pryd03", "moc_pryd04",
		"moc_pryd05", "moc_pryd06", "moc_prydb1", "in_sphinx1", "in_sphinx2", "in_sphinx3",
		"in_sphinx4", "in_sphinx5", "job_thief1", "in_moc_16", "que_job01", "in_rogue";
	.start$ = "morocc";
	.start_x = 156;
	.start_y = 46;
	// The portals at the edge of the world.
	disablenpc "cmd_fild08-1";
	disablenpc "cmd_fild08-2";
	disablenpc "cmd_fild08-3";
	disablenpc "cmd_fild09-1";
	disablenpc "moc005";
	disablenpc "mocf13-1";
	disablenpc "mocf20-1";
	disablenpc "mocf23";
	disablenpc "mocf26-1";
	disablenpc "mocf27-1";
	disablenpc "rogue00-fild07";
	disablenpc "rogue03-fild07";
	disablenpc "rogue06-fild04";
	end;

OnPCLoadMapEvent:
	if (getgroupid() >= 99)
		end;
	getmapxy(.@map$, .@x, .@y);
	if (inarray(.maps$[0], .@map$) >= 0) {
		@sub_world_map$ = .@map$;
		@sub_world_x = .@x;
		@sub_world_y = .@y;
		if (inarray(.maps$[0], getsavepoint(0)) < 0)
			savepoint .start$, .start_x, .start_y;
		end;
	}
	dispbottom "The way beyond is closed. You are taken back.";
	if (@sub_world_map$ == "")
		warp .start$, .start_x, .start_y;
	else
		warp @sub_world_map$, @sub_world_x, @sub_world_y;
	end;
}
